A '''Massassi monument''' was located north of the [[Massassi Site/Legends|Massassi Site]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. From its peak, an extensive landscape could be seen, with the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], the [[Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster/Legends|Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster]], and the [[Palace of the Woolamander]] in the distance. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] established its quarters on Yavin 4. Because of the mists and wildlife of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]], the Alliance could not rely on automated [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], which prompted them to build several [[Sentry tower/Legends|recon-towers]]. One of them, [[recon-tower 4]], was built atop the unidentified monument. Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|battle]] between the Alliance and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] new [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Osleo Prennert]] manned recon-tower 4 from the monument's roof.<ref name="SWI92" />
